limits: Nominal rigid geometry and sourced alternatives only. Raw PA12 guide fits, clamp creep/slip, gear backlash, bearing fits, actual loaded servo travel and wiring remain physical qualification items. Alternate configuration full build/validation is separate from default pinned baseline approval.

continuous_support_frame_clearance.flange: Exact unperforated flange face-prism sweep; zero intersection over the designed1.19mm adjustment span.
continuous_support_frame_clearance.remaining_support: Adaptive translation-distance certificate; one certified interval; zero collision
continuous_support_frame_clearance.final_frame_change: Subsequent upper-face reduction removes material from the obstacle; preserves the conservative sweep result

shared_slide_geometry_review.clearance_sampling: 25 output angles from -180 to180 degrees at both mesh-clearance extremes; this clearance minimum is sampled, not a continuous rotation certificate
shared_slide_geometry_review.mass_basis: CAD solid volume times1.01g/cm3 PA12 reference density; unmeasured
shared_slide_geometry_review.locking_limit: Two retained M2 clamps hold the position by friction; no positive radial lock. Validate loaded reversing motion and PA12 settling. A slipping60T input can unmesh before the full physical slot limit.
shared_slide_geometry_review.adjustment_span_scope: Nominal slot-centreline stroke for gear substitution plus fine mesh setting; bolt/hole clearance adds play, so this is not a measured mechanical hard-stop range.

clamp_contact_tradeoff.method: Coplanar BRep face-common area from the native clamp-fastener check; no load or contact-pressure distribution is solved.
clamp_contact_tradeoff.comparison_scope: Previous short-slot nominal contact only; current 60/20 and 64/20 at both fine-mesh endpoints. Both sides and both input-mount bolts are checked.
clamp_contact_tradeoff.interpretation: Reduced seating area raises average bearing pressure for the same assumed preload; it does not establish an equivalent loss of friction capacity. Preload, PA12 compression/creep and slip resistance remain unmeasured. The longer slot also permits loss of mesh if the clamp slips; no equal-strength qualification is claimed.

alternative_integration.scope: Temporary 64_20 source-selected integration audit; no alternative approved fixture, compare or release bundle.

final_verification.outer_input_cap_service_order: For either gear choice: remove module and leads, remove output gear and cartridge mounting pairs, withdraw cartridge by its verified path, remove driver gear axially, then service the outer bearing cap. Full validation requires the cartridge and gear path checks to pass before accepting the cap fastener path.
final_verification.step_identity_scope: Raw scalar volume differences remain recorded. Only valid closed single-solid inputs with topologically empty cuts in both directions may bypass the scalar integral discrepancy; geometric difference and bounds gates stay unchanged. Regression tests reject moved equal-volume cavities and small real material removal.
final_verification.limits: CAD fit-prototype checks only; installed clamp retention, PA12 creep, servo travel/torque, actual bought fits and wiring remain unqualified.
